evidence_ledger.claim: The OMP runtime plane is observed live at the current revision (supported run path: PSTACK_RUN_OMP_LIVE=1 python3 scripts/verify_portable.py run --host omp): a bounded omp --mode rpc v2 session negotiated protocol v2, spawned and joined one real model-backed `task` child, and reduced it to a typed settlement on runtime-child-spawn-omp, alongside a cancelled settlement on runtime-child-cancel-omp and an isolation settlement on runtime-isolation-omp. Those three settlements are what promote agent.spawn, agent.join, agent.cancel and workspace.isolated to `verified`, each pinned to the scenario that settles it in .audit/evidence/omp-receipt.json (agent.join reads the spawn scenario's completion path; agent.cancel is the capability-scoped cancellation settlement). The profile still claims `packaged`, not `verified`, because the rest of the mandatory floor (workspace.shared, workspace.readonly, human.ask, plan.update, verify, evidence.capture) has no live settlement and stays static-only; the package plane remains an offline lifecycle fixture, while the native installed-package load is proven separately by scripts/prove_omp_native_package.py against the real binary.
